# Lift (auto-generated by `python -m rnd.run_all`)

Moving mass 12.3 kg + 2 kg payload; travel 0.35–1.05 m; accel 1.0 m/s².

| Option | Mass (kg) | Cost ($, ESTIMATE) | Speed (m/s) | Power-off | Holding power | Main risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: NEMA23 2 N·m + 24 V brake, GT2 belt (v0 placeholder) | 1.25 | 75 | 0.25 | spring-applied brake (fail-safe) | 4.5 W | heaviest; another motor type + driver to stock |
| B: constant-force springs + NEMA17 | 0.60 | 80 | 0.30 | springs balance; drifts with payload; needs a brake anyway | 0 W | springs shoot the carriage up when the arms come off (carry mode); CF-spring fatigue 2.5k–25k cycles |
| C: GIM6010-8 cartridge + HTD 5M belt + spring-applied ratchet pawl (solenoid release) **← chosen** | 0.55 | 95 | 0.20 | pawl drops into the ratchet whenever power is off (fail-safe); 0 W at rest | 0 W | clicks if the pawl isn't held off while rising; height stops are 5 mm-quantised when parked |
| D: self-locking lead screw Tr12×3 + NEMA17 | 0.70 | 60 | 0.03 | self-locking screw | 0 W | 0.7 m of travel takes ~23 s; long screw whips |

## Option C numbers

| Check | Value |
|---|---|
| Force (moving + payload, with accel) | 154 N |
| Motor torque on a 20T HTD 5M pulley | 2.45 N·m → **2.04×** rated margin |
| Speed at rated rpm / full travel | 0.20 m/s / 3.5 s (faster when lightly loaded, up to ~420 rpm) |
| Belt (15 mm HTD 5M, open-ended along the spine) | safety 6.3× |
| Pawl catch after a power loss mid-move (×3 shock) | ratchet tooth shear 9.3 MPa in PETG (limit ~30) |

**Why C:** it's the lightest and uses the standard GIM cartridge (motors are reusable across builds). It holds with **zero power** at rest, and it's fail-safe: the pawl is spring-applied and solenoid-released, so losing power drops it into the ratchet. Precedent: spring-applied / power-released safety brakes and ratchet fall arrest (stair lifts, hoists, FRC climbers).
**Carry mode:** park at the lowest stop with the pawl engaged; nothing is spring-loaded, so removing the arms is safe (unlike B).
**Lowering sequence:** lift 2 mm to unload the pawl → solenoid retracts it → move → solenoid off → settle onto the next tooth.
